channel.title: Tool Site HOT
channel.description: Tool Site HOT lists only tool websites you can use right away — converters, formatters, image tools, code tools and more. It discovers the newest tool sites every day from Product Hunt, Hacker News, Reddit and more, scores them by rules, and shows only the title, a one-line summary and a link to the original — no articles, no news, no full text republished.

item.title: RoomDesign Genius
item.description: Upload a photo of your room and get four AI redesigns in your chosen style, plus free in-browser floor plan tools.

item.title: Director's Lookbook, named looks for image, video and music prompts
item.description: Pick a mood and a subject and it hands you a ready-made visual style, with matching image, video and music prompts to copy straight into your AI tools.

item.title: Toolmaker Agent: A Development Workbench for Humans and AI Agents
item.description: A development workbench where humans and AI coding agents share one structured record of the project and keep building from it.

item.title: Endlessle — Krillion Unlimited
item.description: A free rare-answer trivia game in your browser — seven prompts per dive, rarer answers dive deeper, with no daily cap.

item.title: Power Size Guide
item.description: Pick your appliances and hours, and it tells you the Wh capacity, watts and surge your portable power station needs.

item.title: Soul Virtues Extractor
item.description: A free 66-question test that reads your Undertale SOUL traits and shows how much Determination, Bravery and Justice you carry.

item.title: Unblurfy
item.description: Fix shaky, out-of-focus and low-resolution photos with AI in about 30 seconds — free to try, no watermark.

item.title: Qlyro
item.description: Fifty-two free tools that run in your browser — grades, time, JSON and CSV, Markdown, hashes, text to PDF and more, no sign-up needed.

item.title: Morse Zone
item.description: A free online Morse code translator with audio and practice tools — sending Morse is easier than it sounds.

item.title: silo.host
item.description: Websites you can talk to — describe a site in plain words and watch the layout and content change live, with hosting included.

item.title: Photo to Sticker
item.description: Turn your photo into stickers — free instant stickers and AI expression packs for your chats.

item.title: Show HN: Your Spreadsheet Is Your Database
item.description: Use your spreadsheet as the database and turn it into a working app without writing a backend.

item.title: Show HN: Convert EML/MBOX mailboxes to PDF in the browser, no upload
item.description: Drop EML or MBOX mailbox files into the browser and turn them into PDFs — one per email or one merged file — all processed locally, nothing uploaded.

item.title: Tinnitus frequency finder and audio notch tool
item.description: A free guided tinnitus pitch match that runs entirely in your browser: it calibrates levels to your hearing, narrows down your tinnitus pitch by comparing sounds, and guards against the common one-octave mistake.

item.title: Agents Please: Project Badges to Show LLM Preferences
item.description: Declare your project's stance on AI use — pick Yes or No and get a badge for your README, so everyone knows at a glance.

item.title: Rentsera
item.description: Property management for Canadian landlords, with an AI assistant handling the busywork: collect rent online, manage leases, maintenance and accounting, all in the browser.

item.title: Morse
item.description: Chat with 80+ AI models in a privacy-first app: your chats stay encrypted on your own device, unreadable even to Morse, with an end-to-end encrypted mode.

item.title: Show HN: A free interactive course on AI agent governance
item.description: A free interactive course on AI agent governance you can take right in the browser — Module 1 needs no registration, learn by doing.

item.title: Show HN: Toolbelt – Free developer utilities that run in the browser
item.description: Eight everyday dev utilities — JSON cleanup, JWT inspection, Base64 conversion, hash generation and more — all running in your browser, with your data staying local.

item.title: Agents API by Recall.ai
item.description: Send your AI agent into video meetings with one API call, giving it a voice and video tile to listen, speak, and share its screen in real time.
